name: effect-flue
description: Flue's Support Agent example, rebuilt in Effect v4 + alchemy-effect. Proves the framework isn't necessary.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: bun run --filter @effect-flue/web build && bun run --filter @effect-flue/api typecheck
